text:
maria: Quick question — for the staged A/B -> canary plan we're doing next week: who owns the "staggered shadow warmup" steps (priming caches, seeding KV, running smoke probes) vs the actual traffic cuts? I want a short checklist so oncall and platform know who to ping.

sam: Platform should own the priming + orchestration of the warmup jobs. App teams own the validation probes and acceptance criteria. Platform triggers, app validates. :+1:

lee: FWIW I suggest a tiny checklist we can add to the runbook: 
1) create shadow variant (platform)
2) run bulk prefix priming job (platform)
3) run smoke probes against pinned prompts (app)
4) run integrity checks (app)
5) open pilot traffic (platform, 1%)
6) monitor metrics for 30m, then 5% etc

jess: + add explicit auto-fallback policy here. If any of: p99 latency > 2x baseline for 5m, or model correctness regression above threshold, then route traffic back to primary and mark variant degraded. Need a boolean `auto_evacuate` in the rollout config.

maria: Agree. Can we sketch a rollout config that encodes ownership and the auto-fallback? Example: 
```yaml
rollout:
  variant: shadow-x-v2
  owners:
    orchestration: platform-team@redwood.com
    validation: product-team@redwood.com
  warmup:
    priming_job: kv_prefix_preload
    smoke_set: /evals/pilot/smoke.json
  policy:
    auto_evacuate: true
    latency_threshold_ms: 1200
    regression_threshold_pct: 2
    evaluation_window_min: 5
```

sam: Nice. A couple of edge cases: 
- Priming should be prioritized by tenant weight (don’t overload hoggers).
- For multi-tenant hosts we need to expose `priming_scope: tenant|global` so platform can opt-in or out.

lee: Also add a `grace_period` in the policy so we don't flip on transient blips: e.g. grace_period: 300s.

jess: And telemetry: tag all warmup calls with `x-rollout-stage=warmup` so we can isolate cost and KV hit rate in the Console. We should also emit a `rollout.step` span for tracing.

maria: Can we pick owners now? @sam you ok to own the priming job orchestration and adding the `priming_scope` knob?

sam: Yep, I'll own orchestration. I'll add a small API on the rollout controller: `POST /rollouts/:id/warmup` that kicks priming jobs and returns job ids.

lee: I'll draft the smoke set and the acceptance probes, and add them to /evals/pilot.

jess: I'll update the runbook with the auto_evacuate entry and add the trace/span hooks.

deploy-bot: warmup-job-9821 started for rollout shadow-x-v2 (initiated by sam)

maria: Thanks — action items: sam add endpoint + priming_scope, lee add smoke probes, jess update runbook. I'll schedule a 30m dry-run with oncall tomorrow at 09:30. :calendar: 

sam: I'll post the PR for the rollout controller and a tiny simulation test so we can prove `auto_evacuate` flips correctly.

lee: One more ask: make sure the cache seeding job can run in dry-run mode (no traffic cut) so oncall can validate without risk.

maria: Good catch. We'll keep dry-run as default for the first warmup.

jess: Links I'll add to the runbook: console dashboard URL + perf baseline query + the smoke set path.

maria: Great thread, thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the calendar invite and the checklist in the runbook.
